name: Evangelists
overview: Scripture reveals that evangelists are empowered by the Holy Ghost to be witnesses for Christ, proclaiming the gospel from local to global spheres as seen in Acts 1:8. Their message calls for repentance, faith in Jesus Christ, and baptism for the remission of sins, emphasizing salvation by grace through faith as taught in Ephesians 2:8 and Mark 16:16. Living by faith in the Son of God, who gave Himself for us, defines the evangelist's life and mission according to Galatians 2:20.
